title: Plugin settings
description: Response from GET and PUT /cms-api/v1/admin/plugins/{pluginId}/settings (contract C14). One entry per setting the plugin manifest declares. A secret is never returned: value is null, has_value says whether one is set, and hint is its last 4 characters when it has 12 or more.

has_value.description: True when an environment override or a stored value is in effect (the default does not count).

value.description: The value in effect, as the declared type; null for a secret or when nothing is set and there is no default.

hint.description: The last 4 characters of a secret of 12 or more characters; otherwise null.

overridden_by_env.description: True when the environment variable named by envOverride is set and decides the value.
